title: NoticeOutputSchema
description: Standardized schema contract for structured, evidence-linked extraction of official notices aligned with the Notice to Action PRD.

notice_id.description: Unique identifier for the notice record or processing job.

schema_version.description: Version of this output schema contract.

notice_title.description: Official title or subject line of the notice.

issuing_organisation.description: Issuing government department, municipal authority, university, or bank.

affected_party.description: Designated audience, beneficiary group, or consumer affected by the notice.

main_purpose.description: Primary goal or objective of the notice as stated in the text.

plain_language_summary.description: Deconstructed non-technical summary broken down into 5 key dimensions.

what_is_this.description: Clear explanation of what document this is, or 'not_found'.

why_it_matters.description: Why this notice is important to the recipient, or 'not_found'.

where_to_do_it.description: Location, portal, or counter to take action, or 'not_found'.

if_deadline_missed.description: Consequences if deadline is missed, or 'not_found'.

deadlines.description: List of explicit or relative deadlines identified in the notice.

date.description: Explicit due date (ISO string or raw date text) or 'not_found' / 'uncertain'.

description.description: Explanation of what must be submitted or performed by this deadline, or 'not_found' / 'uncertain'.

evidence_quote.description: Verbatim quotation from the source text, or 'not_found' / 'uncertain'.

source_page.description: 1-indexed page number containing the deadline, or 'not_found' / 'uncertain' / null.

confidence.description: Extraction confidence score between 0.0 and 1.0, or 'not_found' / 'uncertain'.

is_ambiguous_or_conflicting.description: Flag set to true if date is ambiguous (e.g. relative without base date) or contradictory across sections (FR-04).

ambiguity_reason.description: Short explanation for why the deadline is marked ambiguous or conflicting.

required_documents.description: Checklist of documents, certificates, or identity proofs mentioned in the notice.

is_required.description: True if document is legally or procedurally mandatory; false if optional, recommended, or conditional.

evidence_quote.description: Verbatim quote where this document is mentioned, or 'not_found' / 'uncertain'.

source_page.description: 1-indexed page number where document requirement appears, or 'not_found' / 'uncertain' / null.

status.description: Current checklist status for the document.

submission_channel.description: Primary submission mode, portal URL, physical counter, or postal address.

channel.description: Submission portal URL, counter address, or email, or 'not_found' / 'uncertain'.

evidence_quote.description: Verbatim quote indicating submission channel, or 'not_found' / 'uncertain'.

source_page.description: 1-indexed page number specifying the submission channel, or 'not_found' / 'uncertain' / null.

penalties.description: Financial penalties, late fees, interest, or consequences specified in notice.

description.description: Description of penalty or consequence, or 'not_found' / 'uncertain'.

amount.description: Stated penalty amount or rate, or null / 'not_found' / 'uncertain'.

evidence_quote.description: Verbatim quote describing the penalty, or 'not_found' / 'uncertain'.

source_page.description: 1-indexed page number describing penalty, or 'not_found' / 'uncertain' / null.

action_steps.description: Chronological ordered sequence of action steps for the recipient.

action.description: Direct, actionable instruction strictly derived from notice text, or 'not_found' / 'uncertain'.

evidence_quote.description: Verbatim quote instructing this action, or 'not_found' / 'uncertain'.

source_page.description: 1-indexed page number containing the instruction, or 'not_found' / 'uncertain' / null.

warnings.description: Important conditions, cautions, or uncertainties noted in the notice.

warning_text.description: Description of the warning, caution, or uncertainty condition.

evidence_quote.description: Verbatim quote supporting the warning, or 'not_found' / 'uncertain' / null.

needs_verification.description: Overall flag set to true if any extracted item is uncertain, ambiguous, conflicting, or unverified.

CategoryEnum.description: Canonical classification categories for official notices.

evidence_quote.description: Verbatim quote backing this field, or 'not_found' / 'uncertain'.
